policy: Do not settle a fixture unless a source record identifies the exact match date, home team, away team, full-time and half-time. Key formal-ticket legs require two independent reliable sources.

visualAcceptance.baseImage: Use only the immutable locked original-ticket image as the review scan base; do not redraw it.
visualAcceptance.markerRule: Each hit marker must be centered around the exact hit text, with a consistent size and stroke. Never circle an entire table cell.

columnScope.recommended: Circle only the hit text in the recommendation column.
columnScope.speculative: Circle only the hit text in the speculative column.
columnScope.goals: Circle only the specific hit goal-count number.
columnScope.halfFull: Circle only the specific hit half/full text.
columnScope.score: Circle only the specific hit score text.

visualAcceptance.collisionRule: Markers must not overlap stars, actual result text, adjacent columns, or other markers.
visualAcceptance.verification: Before publication, inspect every marker's coordinates at original PNG resolution and correct any offset before publishing.
